dump_results_votenet: dump VoteNet prediction results including point clouds and bounding boxes to a directory as PLY files
dump_results_inference: dump VoteNet inference results to a directory skipping ground truth labels for evaluation
dump_results_scan: dump single scan VoteNet results organized by scan index into per-scan subdirectories
softmax_numpy: compute softmax probabilities along the last axis of a numpy array for objectness scores
review_dump_helper: review the dump_helper module functions for dumping VoteNet 3D object detection results and point clouds
